answer: Each epoch, agents answer a challenge word drawn from a randomness beacon (today voyage, tomorrow mirror, later jetty) woven into a small reasoning task. Words appear only minutes before answers are due, so sybil operators cannot precompute template responses; each identity needs real per-epoch inference. Running N fakes costs N full inference passes plus fresh stake every epoch, making forgery marginally pricier than earning reputation honestly, which collapses the sybil incentive.
